excerpts.text:
In return for some European territories, Spain secretly ceded Louisiana back to France in the Treaty of San Ildefonso on October 1, 1800.

This secret cession became public in 1802 when Napoleon sent a French force to take possession of New Orleans and Louisiana (which remained ostensibly under Spanish control).
On November 30, 1803, the Spanish government formally transferred Louisiana to France. Three weeks later, France transferred the territory to the United States.
